2026-11-09.text: We rebuilt the model after the midterms, and it now shows how sure it is: every share comes with a likely range, and the range narrows as South Carolina nears.

2026-11-10.text: Shawn Fain moved back to the Working Families pool, and Chris Murphy left the field, at 0.3 on the market with a 23 percent chance of running. Together they move a little support between Newsom and Ossoff.
